description: Comunidad de Madrid: wastewater datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad de Madrid. Coverage: Comunidad de Madrid. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Encuesta de Infraestructuras y Equipamientos Locales (EIEL) - Fase 202; Estaciones depuradoras de aguas residuales (EDAR) del Canal de Isabel ; Recogida de aguas residuales. Formats seen: PLAIN, HTML, WMS_XML, CSV, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
